scientific_integrity: Finite-state checker replays 2622 assertions; the all-size theorem, strict ordering, and all-optimizer proportional-limit are established analytically. The checker is corroborating evidence, not a proof of an infinite assertion.
scientific_limitations: Observed vertex-sequence entropy under a fixed one-root discrete-time resetting rule; proportional-size asymptotic requires both sides growing linearly; no claim of finite-size optimizer uniqueness, hidden reset-action entropy, global publication priority, or independent verification.
title: Golden-ratio entropy-optimal resetting on dense complete bipartite graphs
